A '''cave''' was located on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], deep in the [[Flesh Raider]] territory. In [[3643 BBY]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Nalen Raloch]] established a camp inside the cave.
